title: genista iberica
intro: Genista iberica, commonly known as Spanish broom, is a flowering plant that belongs to the pea family. It has been used in traditional medicine to promote health and well-being, with reported benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce stress, improve digestion, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Genista iberica include its ability to stimulate circulation, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to have a positive impact on cardiovascular health and other diseases.
